title: Pattern work with traffic: follow the Cherokee

briefing.description: Touch-and-go practice on a day when you're not the only one in the pattern. Tower will sequence you behind other traffic — your job is to spot the traffic, tell them you see it, and read back your option clearance. “Cleared for the option” means you may do a touch-and-go, stop-and-go, low approach, or full stop.
briefing.atisText: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Few clouds at four thousand five hundred. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.

steps.speaker: ATIS
steps.text: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Few clouds at four thousand five hundred. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.
You're 10 miles {direction}, inbound for pattern work. The frequency is lively today.

steps.prompt: Call Tower: position, ATIS, and your request — touch and goes.
steps.hint: Centerville Tower, Skyhawk {callsign}, one zero miles {direction} with information {atis}, request touch and goes.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign on initial contact.

elements.label: the ATIS code
elements.feedbackWrong: You said information {heard}, but the current ATIS is {atis}.

elements.label: the request (touch and goes)
elements.feedbackMissing: Say what you want: “request touch and goes”.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Centerville Tower, enter left downwind runway {rwy}, report midfield.

steps.prompt: Read back the entry and report point.
steps.hint: Enter left downwind runway {rwy}, will report midfield, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: pattern entry readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the entry: “left downwind runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but Tower said runway {rwy}.

elements.label: the report point
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the report point: “will report midfield”.

steps.text: You join the downwind and reach midfield. Time to report.

elements.label: midfield report
elements.feedbackMissing: Report the position Tower asked for: “midfield left downwind”.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, number two, follow the Cherokee on left base.

steps.prompt: Look for the Cherokee — there, on base. Tell Tower you have the traffic and your sequence.
steps.hint: Number two, traffic in sight, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: traffic in sight
elements.feedbackMissing: Tell Tower you see the traffic: “traffic in sight”. If you DON'T see it, say “looking for traffic” — never claim traffic you don't have.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, runway {rwy}, cleared for the option.

steps.hint: Cleared for the option runway {rwy}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: option clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the clearance: “cleared for the option”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared on runway {rwy}.

steps.text: You follow the Cherokee, touch down, reconfigure, and lift off again. Back on the crosswind, then downwind for another lap.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, make this one a full stop, runway {rwy}, cleared to land.

steps.prompt: Tower wants this one to be a full stop. Read it back.
steps.hint: Full stop, cleared to land runway {rwy}, Skyhawk {callsign}.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you're cleared on runway {rwy}.

steps.text: Full-stop landing complete. Sequencing behind traffic, option clearances, a mid-pattern change of plan — that was real pattern work.
